CustomField.description: Whether the Module Manager hides the nonprofit modules, the ones only the Nonprofit Edition offers. Unticked or never set, they show; ticked, they are hidden and installed ones are counted. Hides rows only. Written by the Module Manager's Show Nonprofit Modules checkbox, which is the inverse of this field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Hide the nonprofit modules in the Module Manager.
CustomField.label: Hide Nonprofit Modules
